title: Binding constraints and the identity-monodromy case
proved_in_manuscript: Exact binding Euler-characteristic and genus identities.
At least k+1 spherical binding components for a simply connected open book with b2=2k.
Sharpness on standard connected sums of S2 x S2.
Classification of the boundary-relative identity-monodromy simply connected case.
known_countercheck: A sphere twist on S2 x I is homologically trivial but changes the total manifold to the odd S2-bundle over S2.
remaining_gap: Unrestricted monodromy on arbitrary simply connected smooth signature-zero four-manifolds, including exotic smoothings.
